semanticCorrections: Frame admission and main-thread queue options apply to both scheduler strategies; worker count applies only to the worker pool.
Worker count defaults and positive values are capped at 64; single-thread mode does not consume that setting.
Pending retirement retains the current resource and lower dependencies rather than attempting every resource unconditionally.
YieldInstruction has an internal abstract factory and is not an externally implementable custom-wait boundary.
Coroutine waits also accept direct Task and CoroutineHandle values; unsupported yielded objects terminate the routine.
JobHandle.isValid checks identifier shape, not owner identity, current liveness or successful completion.
A previously pending main-thread callback advances before the bounded waiting snapshot is selected.
A retirement deadline cannot preempt a blocking callback and is distinct from CI build-duration monitoring.
